scenes.line1: How do you merge code safely?
scenes.line2: What makes a great pull request?
scenes.say: How do you merge code safely? What makes a great pull request?

scenes.label: Proposal
scenes.sub: Suggest merging changes for review and discussion.
scenes.say: A pull request is a proposal to merge changes. It lets teammates review and discuss your code.
Use clear descriptions, small changes, and constructive feedback. Always link your pull request to relevant tickets.

scenes.title: PR: Fix login bug
scenes.say: Here's an example: the pull request title is 'Fix login bug.' The description explains it handles empty usernames. A reviewer asks for a test.

scenes.question: What's a common PR mistake?
scenes.right: Avoid big, vague pull requests. Keep them small and well described for easier review.
scenes.say: A common mistake is submitting huge, unclear changes. Keep pull requests small and well described for easier review.
